summary.name: MacPass
summary.one_liner: MacPass is a free, open-source, KeePass-compatible password manager for macOS.
use_cases: Manage KeePass database files on a Mac
Auto-fill credentials into web forms and login dialogs
Convert KDB files to KDBX format
Merge changes between password database files
Track and restore earlier versions of password entries
Generate passwords that meet specific site rules
summary.what_it_does: MacPass is a KeePass-compatible password manager for macOS that reads and writes both legacy KDB and current KDBX files, and can convert between them. It provides Autotype to supply credentials into any text input, with an optional system-wide shortcut for Global Autotype. Entries can be organized with tabs, drag and drop, custom icons (including website-based icons), and QuickLook previews of attachments. The app includes a built-in password generator with adjustable rules, marks expired passwords and makes them searchable, and can merge external changes into a database. Autosave, undo/redo, and optional entry history are also supported.
notable: Reads and writes KDB and KDBX files and converts between them
Merges external database changes and arbitrary files into one database
Plugin system and Sparkle auto updates
caveats: Page says the KDB format is not designed for synchronisation, so merging KDB files is a limitation
